# E-Cell JNCTPU

The official Entrepreneurship Cell of JNCT Professional University (formerly Jai Narain College of Technology), Bhopal. E-Cell JNCTPU acts as a campus startup incubator, innovation hub, and student builder community.

## Core Mission
- **Launch:** Helping student founders turn ideas into viable early-stage businesses.
- **Connect:** Linking student developers, UI/UX designers, and business leads with industry mentors and investors.
- **Innovate:** Hosting hackathons (like InnoHack), ideation sprints, and hands-on founder workshops.
- **Grow:** Facilitating access to early-stage capital, pitch competitions, and official university incubation programs.

## Key Sections & Pages

- [Homepage](https://ecelljnctpu.vercel.app/) - Main overview, community stats, pillars, FAQs, and updates.
- [About Us](https://ecelljnctpu.vercel.app/about) - History of E-Cell JNCTPU, venture incubation mission, detailed FAQs.
- [Team](https://ecelljnctpu.vercel.app/team) - Directory of student leaders, technical coordinators, and domain heads (Core, Tech, Creatives, Marketing, Operations).
- [Events](https://ecelljnctpu.vercel.app/events) - List of active, upcoming, and past startup summits, hackathons, and pitch events.
- [Join Us](https://ecelljnctpu.vercel.app/join) - Recruitment portal for student coordinators and incubation cohorts.
- [Portal / Login](https://ecelljnctpu.vercel.app/login) - Access point for registered members and student founders.
